commercialMode: Retained own-result read; no entitlement to create a sale is granted.
scope: Server tenant/cashier plus original store/terminal/session/sale/client identifier and request hash; verified stored result and current sale status.
effects: Ordinary permission audit only. No commit, receipt completion, payment, posting or delivery.
client: Original validated request in per-tenant/cashier session storage before submission; explicit original retry or reviewed-result acknowledgement.
limits: No cross-device or closed-tab discovery, no full receipt recovery, no retained-obligation refund/void permission change.
